column1: # The highlight classes of Mapal source and what each one is in every highlighter.
# One row per class: the Vim syntax group (editors/nvim/syntax/mapal.vim), the TextMate
# semantic token as type[.modifier] (`mapal lsp`). `-` is "no highlight of its own".
# The editors map each semantic token back to its class's group / scope
# so a name looks the same in Neovim and VS Code, with or without the server.
